description: This source file implements a custom renderer for the blackfriday markdown processor, converting markdown to roff format (used for man pages). It defines a roffRenderer class with methods for rendering various markdown node types into roff syntax, handling headers, lists, tables, and inline elements.

classes.name: roffRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer implementing the blackfriday.Renderer interface for converting markdown to roff format for man pages.

methods.name: NewRoffRenderer
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the roffRenderer for generating roff documents from markdown.

methods.name: GetExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of blackfriday extensions used by this renderer, including tables, fenced code, footnotes, etc.

methods.name: RenderHeader
methods.description: Outputs the document header, enabling table preprocessor if tables are present, and disables hyphenation.

methods.name: RenderFooter
methods.description: Outputs the document footer; this renderer has no footer content.

methods.name: RenderNode
methods.description: Processes each markdown node, converting it into corresponding roff syntax, handling text, headers, lists, tables, links, code blocks, etc.
